name: Midou Yuujirou
source:
He is known as "Mad Dog" Mido because he is infamous around the school as a tough SOB delinquent who always gets involved in street fights. He is full of contradictions. He claims to be a pacifist but gets into fights for reasons as stupid as his nickname suggests. He also doesn't see any problem in personally raping and blackmailing his female friends, but he may feel a twinge of guilt in pimping them to the general public.
